title: Secret world seeds (for the worthy, drunk world, not the bees, don't dig up, the constant, celebrationmk10, no traps, get fixed boi)
player_outcome: Typing a special seed creates Terraria's famous special worlds: For the Worthy (harder enemies and bosses), Drunk World (both evils, odd dungeon), Not the Bees (jungle/hive world), Don't Dig Up (upside-down progression), The Constant (darkness/hunger), Celebration (party), No Traps (traps everywhere), plus 'get fixed boi' combining them.
design: MainMenu.Worlds ParseSeed recognises the names (case/space-insensitive) and sets WorldSettings flags; worldgen passes read the flags deterministically (bump GenVersion once); gameplay modifiers read flags via ConditionContext/DamageModel; a menu hint lists unlocked secret seeds only after discovery (keep them secret).
Start only after the bosses session's W8 Dungeon rewrite is merged (merge origin/claude/ovh-bosses) so seed variants modify the final generator.
Quality bar: what a AAA, realistic 3D Terraria made by Re-Logic would ship. Data-driven, performance-budgeted by graphics preset, Core logic tested, follows docs/overhaul/_BRIEF.md (LEAN MODE).
tests: SecretSeedTests (parse, flags, deterministic generation per seed)
